limitations: Static source assertions explain known UI behavior; they do not prove live hit testing, dialog ownership or product compatibility with another build.

assertions.meaning: Text mask is associated with its context element.
Mask text is an element attribute, not proof of a full workspace overlay.
Repeated mask requests use the context sequence.
Loading is the default lock text.
MethodLock defaults to the element text mask.
Mask ownership follows the specific Views collection.
Discovery must consider Ext button rendering.
The rendered button may be an anchor.
The href getter may return false, so a button need not have href.
